title: Reset to template restores template defaults; Save is only enabled if something changed
preconds:
1. Log in as a user who can edit roles.
  2. At least one custom role (created from a template) exists.
steps:
1. Go to Settings > Roles & Permissions.
  2. Open the custom role with the pencil (Edit) icon.
  3. Click Reset to template.
  4. Look at the Save button.
expected:
If the role's permissions had been changed from the template defaults: Reset to template puts them back to the defaults and enables Save; clicking Save keeps the reset.

If the role still matched the template defaults: Reset to template changes nothing and Save stays disabled.
